## Design

### 2026-11-07: I finished the schematic and PCB. This is the final result (I still need to add the designs on the silkscreen):

**6h**

I finished the schematic and PCB. This is the final result (I still need to add the designs on the silkscreen):

![Screenshot 2026-11-06 at 9.50.12 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/7ME5CuFiz5X4u2KxuO278yO001rQ8Db2/a74a47a7d55c2553016b231e4879ae5b1e17af7ab2c9ebf55ab4bcd733b774dc.png)

I am making a chess clock, so I have 2 screens (1 per player), an ESP32, some solder jumpers, MX switches for the buttons, and then some diodes, resistors, capacitors, wire pads, piezo, and a battery holder. This is the schematic of the ESP32:

![Screenshot 2026-11-06 at 9.05.41 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/7ME5CuFiz5X4u2KxuO278yO001rQ8Db2/3ba13260df8631e7ec12eeb852c0987a5a6021bd1fecf6a7b475cefe4cdbc119.png)

Everything is connected to that. The next important thing are the screens:

![Screenshot 2026-11-06 at 9.06.10 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/7ME5CuFiz5X4u2KxuO278yO001rQ8Db2/7047cd886e8bc638a49ec0b3ae713bfc666a3e6bf37e6e5e71e32b3724877c27.png)
